subject: Graceful restart — promo credit & short extension for Aptiv trial
messages:
From: Nina Patel <nina@aptivsolutions.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Trial access expired — request for quick extension

Hi Jordan,

Our Aptiv trial stopped overnight when we hit a quota limit — several engineers were blocked during integration tests and we couldn't finish an end-to-end run. Can you help with a short credit extension or a small promo top-up so the team can complete validation? We have an internal demo scheduled for Nov 26 and need the environment stable for a week of dry runs.

I've attached a small usage snapshot to show token patterns. If it helps, we can sign a quick amendment for one-time credits.

Thanks,
Nina Patel
Head of AI Platforms, Aptiv Solutions
Attachment: usage-snapshot.csv (csv, 42KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina@aptivsolutions.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T12:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Trial access expired — request for quick extension

Hi Nina — thanks for flagging this and for the snapshot.

Two quick paths we can take so you can finish validation before the demo:

1) Short extension: 7-day extension to the sandbox + 50% promo top-up on current remaining credits (fastest to apply).
2) One-time top-up: a $1,000 sandbox credit addition (applied immediately).

If you need until Nov 26 specifically, option 2 is lowest friction. Either option would require a short amendment (DocuSign) for audit and tracking — I can push that through the approvals desk once you pick an option.

A couple quick asks to make sure we size this correctly: how many active developers will be running tests over the next two weeks, and roughly how many tokens / calls per day do you expect? That will help me pick the right size top-up if you want us to recommend one.

Happy to jump on a 15-min call if that's easier.

— Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0189

From: Nina Patel <nina@aptivsolutions.com>

Date: 2026-11-20T08:44:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Trial access expired — request for quick extension

> Hi Nina — thanks for flagging this and for the snapshot.

> Two quick paths we can take so you can finish validation before the demo:

Thanks, Jordan. Apologies for the urgency — dev team ramped up faster than anticipated. Quick answers below:
- Active devs running tests this week: 6 (mostly infra + 2 app engineers).
- Expected peak: ~120k tokens/day for a 2–3 day run; otherwise 25–40k tokens/day.

Given the schedule, we'd prefer a 14-day extension if possible (so the team can run final regression and a dry run). If that's not on the table, the $1,000 top-up would also work — we can aim to compress validation.

I've attached a fuller usage report. Backdating the credits to last night would be ideal so we don't lose the interrupted tests.

Appreciate the help — happy to sign whatever amendment you need.

Nina
Attachment: usage-report.csv (csv, 180KB)

- 6 active devs; peak ~120k tokens/day for 2–3 day runs; typical 25–40k/day otherwise.
- Customer requests a 14-day extension (preferred) or $1,000 one-time sandbox credit. They also want credits backdated to last night if possible.
- Internal need: we want to avoid setting a recurring credit; this should be a one-off make-good to preserve the trial experience and keep the deal moving (deal id: RDW-APT-2026-099).

Suggested approval options for sign-off:
A) Approve 14-day extension and apply a 50% promo top-up to their remaining sandbox balance (limit total exposure to $1,200).
B) Approve one-time $1,000 top-up only.

I can handle the DocuSign amendment and HubSpot notes. Also attaching their usage report and the snapshot Nina sent.

Attachments: usage-report.csv, usage-snapshot.csv

— Jordan
